poetryFrame.leftVertical: A THOUSAND YEARS OF SILENCE ECHOING IN THE VEIL.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: THE HEARTBEAT ACCELERATES, A PULSE AGAINST THE TURNING TIDE.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS IS WHERE FOREVER BEGINS TO UNFOLD.

lyrics.text: Heart beats fast
Colors and promises
How to be brave?
How can I love when I'm afraid to fall
But watching you stand alone?
All of my doubt suddenly goes away somehow
One step closer
I have died everyday waiting for you
Darling don't be afraid I have loved you
For a thousand years
I'll love you for a thousand more
Time stands still
Beauty in all she is
I will be brave
I will not let anything take away
What's standing in front of me
Every breath
Every hour has come to this
One step closer
I have died everyday waiting for you
Darling don't be afraid I have loved you
For a thousand years
I'll love you for a thousand more
And all along I believed I would find you
Time has brought your heart to me
I have loved you for a thousand years
I'll love you for a thousand more
